content:
Confirmed: Die_Back shows completely withered/curled brown leaves, and Powdery_Mildew shows white powdery patches — neither matches the test image.

The test image shows a green mango leaf with tan-to-brown necrotic spots concentrated along the leaf margins, with some scattered spots on the blade. This matches **Anthracnose** perfectly:
- "Leaf spots ranging from light tan to deep brown with darker edging near leaf margins"
- "Semicircular lesions on margins of young leaves"
- The bottom-right Anthracnose reference image is very similar in appearance

It's not Bacterial_Canker (those have angular, raised, black spots with serrated margins). Not Gall_Midge (round blister galls), Cutting_Weevil (stripped shoots), Die_Back (withered curled leaves), Powdery_Mildew (white coating), or Sooty_Mould (black coating).

Spots are flat/irregular, not raised or angular (ruling out Bacterial_Canker). No galls, white powder, black coating, or leaf curling/stripping seen."}
